market_outlook.short_term: Bond market stress is the dominant near-term risk. Yields at 20-year highs with oil above $103 create a stagflationary pressure. Equities face headwinds from rate sensitivity but find support in AI capex and resilient consumer staples. Expect elevated volatility. European stocks may continue modest gains as oil eases. JPY remains a flashpoint. Trump-Xi truce extension provides 2-month window of reduced trade risk.
market_outlook.long_term: AI remains the primary structural growth driver across biology, networking, and consumer. However, rapid rate rises historically precede financial stress ('something always breaks'). El Niño 2027 commodity squeeze adds inflation tail risk. US-China trade truce is fragile. BOJ policy normalization will likely accelerate, reshaping global liquidity. Housing correction risk builds in rate-sensitive markets. Defense and industrial consolidation continues.
